text:
Type: fabric storage box
Use: storing clothes, toys, blankets or papers on shelves; bedroom, living room, children's room
Style: Scandinavian, coastal, farmhouse
Materials: sturdy padded fabric with lattice stitching, turned-down cuff, piped edges
Colors: light beige, cobalt blue lines
Shape: rectangular soft box with a folded-over rim, a diamond lattice pattern in thin blue lines, rounded piped edges, softly structured, medium size
Feel: tidy, homey, fresh, gentle
Goes with: white shelving, light wood, blue and white textiles; Scandinavian, coastal or farmhouse rooms

product.name: SKUBBARE
product.description: You can decide the height of the basket yourself by folding the edges. The folded edge also makes a handy lip for pulling out the basket.
